svg.aria-label: Barbell deadlift, Setup: Set the bar over midfoot, grip just outside your legs, and brace.
svg.title: Barbell deadlift, Setup: Set the bar over midfoot, grip just outside your legs, and brace.

svg.aria-label: Barbell deadlift, Lift: Push through your feet and keep the bar close as it passes your knees.
svg.title: Barbell deadlift, Lift: Push through your feet and keep the bar close as it passes your knees.

svg.aria-label: Barbell deadlift, Stand: Stand tall with long arms and the bar close to your thighs.
svg.title: Barbell deadlift, Stand: Stand tall with long arms and the bar close to your thighs.

svg.aria-label: Barbell deadlift, Lower: Send your hips back, then bend your knees to return the bar to the floor.
svg.title: Barbell deadlift, Lower: Send your hips back, then bend your knees to return the bar to the floor.
